items.title: Mordell-Weil rank bound from freely movable rational curves in an elliptic fibration base
items.author: Antonella Grassi; Rick Miranda; Kapil Paranjape; Vasudevan Srinivas; Timo Weigand
items.difficulty_reason: The structure theorem reduces an elliptic fibration over a higher-transcendence-degree function field to a smooth proper elliptic surface over an auxiliary function field, controls Mordell-Weil restriction/base change and applies Noether/Picard-rank bounds. The full author moving-curve and singularity hypotheses are essential context and remain unchanged. This is the paper independent arithmetic method rather than the old geometric height support lemma or a numerical application.

primary.label: complete original main2 structural function-field rank theorem and full hypotheses

proof_spans.label: complete original function-field spreading, reduction to surfaces and Noether rank-bound proof

contexts.label: original motivation, definitions of freely movable curves, elliptic minimal models and surface rank formulas
original geometric comparison, restriction injections, CY numerical applications and physics appendix kept as uncounted context
